source: DR 08 T4-3 — TY 2025-26, PF-RPF12-001, independent of the aggregate cap
_source: **Expected: ₹30,000 added to salary, with `PF-AGGCAP-001` contributing nothing.** "PF-AGGCAP-001: aggregate 1,50,000 ≤ 7,50,000 → no excess = 0"; "PF-RPF12-001: 12% of 10,00,000 = 1,20,000 … employer contribution above 12% = 30,000 → taxable". TY 2025-26: 1961 Sch. IV Pt A r.6(a) (D-151). No excess, so no fund history is needed.
